name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russian attacks kill 10 and injure 58 on 25–26 Nov as ballistic missiles hit Kyiv; Zelensky warns of a new energy strike
state: Russian attacks killed 10 people and injured 58 across Ukraine over the day to 26 Nov, as ballistic missiles hit a Kyiv shopping centre and injured seven, regional officials said (Kyiv Independent). Ukraine's air force said Russia launched ballistic missiles and 113 drones overnight to 26 Nov, 87 of them downed (h.ua). On 26 Nov Zelensky said Russia was preparing a new mass attack on energy infrastructure (Kyiv Independent). Sustained mass strikes keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice against all travel to Ukraine. Expect continued disruption to Ukrainian power and transport.
rubric_hit: Mass-casualty strikes and sustained missile barrages: significant escalation
